items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: If you go to the 36th and Gramercy, you probably can catch Alton, what the drummer play at the Diggsland?

ctx.x: If you go to the 36th and Gramercy, you probably can catch Alton, what the drummer play at the Diggsland? Uh... Elton Red? Elton Red. Yeah. He played in the band with Elton Red now.
